title: Waste Recognition
summary: Classifies waste type from a bin photograph and returns a labelled prediction with a confidence score.

trade.notes: Stateless and dependency-free — the most readily separable module in the registry. Buyer needs only a host and a model artifact.

settlement.counterparty_note: COMPLETE AT SIGNING — no counterparty agreed at the time of writing.
settlement.rationale: Stateless, dependency-free and model-agnostic — the cleanest asset to divest. Value sits in the API contract and integration surface, not the stub model, so the buyer supplies their own inference.
conveys: copyright in the software as delivered
the right to use, modify, host and commercially exploit

licence_back.scope: perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free, internal operation of the Omega6.0 Waste Network only
licence_back.why: bin_reporting and worker_dashboard both consume this module's capability. Divesting without a licence-back would stop the product on settlement day.

settlement.post_sale_operation: Continue against our own instance under the licence-back, or repoint the consumer's capability env var at the buyer's hosted endpoint. No code change either way.
